review_frequency: Monthly, or after a material data or operational change

performance_trigger.description: Retrain or investigate when validation MAE or RMSE worsens materially against the approved baseline
performance_trigger.suggested_threshold: 20% deterioration for two consecutive evaluation periods

drift_trigger.description: Investigate model retraining when PSI indicates significant feature or target distribution drift

data_quality_trigger.description: Investigate before retraining if date gaps, duplicate dates, missing target values, or invalid records appear
data_quality_trigger.action: Resolve data quality issues before model training

forecast_stability_trigger.description: Review the model when forecast outputs become unstable or implausible
forecast_stability_trigger.action: Compare against persistence and moving-average baselines

retraining_validation: Compare against the currently deployed model
Evaluate MAE, RMSE and MAPE where appropriate
Check forecast horizons of 1, 7, 14 and 30 days
Review confidence intervals and operational capacity implications
Promote a replacement only after validation and approval
deployment_rule: Never replace the production model automatically based only on a drift alert.
